rl.err.barP <- ggplot(avg, aes(
                                x = trialday, 
                                y = rl.avg.err, 
                                fill = factor(daynum))) +
                 geom_col() +
                 ggtitle(
                         "Average number of errors per trial",
                         subtitle = "Reversal learning task") +
                 scale_x_discrete(
                                  labels = c(
                                             "1", "2", "3", "4", "5",
                                             "6", "7", "8", "9")) +
                 scale_y_continuous(
                                    breaks = c(
                                              0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12)) +
                 theme_clean() +
                 labs(
                      fill = "Day") +
                 scale_fill_hc(
                               "avocado")





test <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    data = avg,
    aes(x = trialday, y = splm.avg.err, fill = daynum),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_col_pattern(
    data = avg,
    aes(x = trialday, y = rl.avg.err, fill = daynum),
    pattern = "stripe",
    pattern_fill = "black",
    pattern_colour = "black",
    pattern_density = 0.1,
    pattern_spacing = 0.03,
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Trial number",
    y = "Average number of errors",
    fill = "Trial day"
  )

test





test2 <- ggplot(avg, aes(x = trialday)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = rl.avg.err, fill = "RL"), position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_col_pattern(aes(y = splm.avg.err, fill = "SPLM"),
    pattern = "stripe", pattern_fill = "#67a956", pattern_colour = "#67a956", pattern_density = 0.2, pattern_spacing = 0.02, position = "identity",  alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "SPLM" = "NA",
      "RL" = "#aa759d"),
    labels = c(
      "Spatial learning & memory",
      "Reversal learning") +
  labs(
    x = "Trial number",
    y = "Average number of errors",
    fill = "Trial type") +
  theme_clean()
    
  

test2
